title: Tactile keypad
description: Four physical keys crop, desaturate and rotate an aerial court photograph; Shift reverses the rotation.
useCase: Make infrequent creative shortcuts discoverable through a small, functioning material control.
interaction: Press C, M and R or the keycaps. Hold Shift with R to rotate backward. Enable sound explicitly if desired.

assets.description: Two green tennis courts seen from above

reducedMotion: Keys change depth immediately; image edits do not animate.
limitations: Local image transformations only. Optional switch sound is synthesized with Web Audio after explicit opt-in.
look: Burnt-orange background with an aerial tennis-court photo in a dark bezel beside a cream plastic keypad of four chunky keys, one charcoal.
motion: Clicking a keycap or pressing C, M or R sinks it 5 px with a collapsing side shadow; release lifts it in 80 ms ease-out; photo edits are instant.
adapt: Key travel is the `tk-key` `data-down` CSS rule (5 px drop, shadow collapse, 80 ms ease-out release), set by `press` and `release`; `clickSound` is optional Web Audio. Replace `KEYS`, the tennis-court image and the `crop`, `mono` and `turn` edits.
